title: Plan Fee at Enrollment and the New-Customer Discount — CareLine Service Plans
content:
**Billing desk clause — CareLine Service Plans plan fee.**

1. The plan fee for a term is billed in advance on the first day of the term as one plan fee charge. It is the plan's fee per term plus, for each covered opening above the base count, the yearly extra-opening fee for every plan year of the term.
2. A plan cannot cover more than its maximum openings, and the service address must lie within the service radius of a Ridgeline branch.
3. A customer whose Ridgeline window or door installation was completed within the new-customer window before the enrolled date receives the plan's new-customer discount on the first term's fee. The new-customer discount applies only when a Ridgeline installation completion date falls within the new-customer window before the enrolled date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the installation completion date, and enrolling on the last day of the window still qualifies.
4. Discounts apply to the plan fee only, never to visit charges, and the new-customer and loyalty discounts never apply to the same term.
5. Amounts are rounded to the cent.

The plan's fee per term, base count, maximum openings, yearly extra-opening fee, service radius, new-customer discount rate and new-customer window are the figures the product schedules set for the plan's tier.

### The fee for a term, in words

The plan fee for a term equals the plan's fee per term, plus the number of covered openings above the base count multiplied by the yearly extra-opening fee and by the number of plan years in the term. Openings up to the base count add nothing.

| Hypothetical inputs | Plan fee for the term |
|---|---|
| Fee per term 300.00; base count 40; 40 covered openings; 12-month term | 300.00 |
| Fee per term 300.00; base count 40; 45 covered openings; yearly extra-opening fee 4.00; 12-month term (one plan year) | 300.00 plus 5 openings multiplied by 4.00 for one plan year, that is 320.00 |
| Fee per term 300.00; base count 30; 35 covered openings; yearly extra-opening fee 2.00; 36-month term (three plan years) | 300.00 plus 5 openings multiplied by 2.00 for three plan years, that is 330.00 |

### Evidence for the new-customer discount

- **The clock starts at** a Ridgeline installation completion date: the completion date the company's records show on the customer's Window Replacement Contracts or Entry & Patio Door Contracts. The customer's own recollection of the date is not the record.
- **Counting.** Calendar days, counted from the day after the installation completion date. Day 1 of the window is the day after completion; the last day of the window is the day whose count equals the new-customer window.
- **Comparison.** The enrolled date must be no later than the last day of the window. Enrolling on the last day of the window still qualifies; enrolling on the day after it does not.
- **Which plan.** The discount is assessed for the plan being enrolled, on its first term's fee.

### Boundary dates (hypothetical, for a plan whose new-customer window is 90 calendar days)

| Installation completion date | Enrolled date | Day of the window | New-customer discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2026 | 11 January 2026 | Day 1 | Applies |
| 10 January 2026 | 10 April 2026 | Day 90, the last day | Applies |
| 10 January 2026 | 11 April 2026 | Day 91 | Does not apply |

### Discount figures (hypothetical inputs, no openings above the base count)

| First term's fee | New-customer discount rate | First term's fee after the discount |
|---|---|---|
| 150.00 | 50% | 75.00 |
| 189.00 | 25% | 141.75 |

The discount never reduces a trip fee, labor, parts, a surcharge or any other visit charge, and a term that receives the new-customer discount does not also receive the loyalty discount.
